m_26_14.description: OPT-IN router: maps stock integration data (NetFlow/IPFIX, Suricata/Snort, DHCP, Packetbeat) to the M-26-14 network-observed device schema and REROUTES it into logs-m_26_14_netobserved.devices, where the m_26_14-network-device-normalize pipeline enriches it (OUI vendor, OT tagging, asset/host entity). Attach this from a dedicated sensor integration's `logs-<dataset>@custom` pipeline via a {pipeline} processor. NOTE: reroute MOVES the document out of its original stream — use only for dedicated inventory/flow/IDS sensors whose data exists solely for network visibility. To COPY instead of move, use a continuous transform (see docs/ot-iot-network-visibility.md).

description: Map + reroute stock network-integration events into the M-26-14 network-observed device inventory (opt-in; attach via logs-<dataset>@custom).

script.description: Set m_26_14.observed_via from the source integration; map app protocol.

set.description: Derive network.segment from the observing sensor's zone when the integration provides one (operator maps observer.ingress.zone to a VLAN/segment label).

reroute.description: Route into the M-26-14 network-observed device inventory data stream.
